title: Multimodal ensemble machine learning pipeline for oocyte fertilization prediction using first polar body morphology and clinical factors
summary: In the reported retrospective ICSI cohort, XGBoost performed best with numerical features; adding first polar body images raised peak fertilization-prediction AUC to 0.82. The result is limited to the evaluated clinical data and does not establish improved reproductive outcomes.
ai_technology: Random Forest and XGBoost combine clinical variables with first polar body (PBI) morphology from oocyte images to predict 2PN fertilization after ICSI.

evidence.tested: In the reported retrospective ICSI cohort, XGBoost performed best with numerical features; adding first polar body images raised peak fertilization-prediction AUC to 0.82.
evidence.unknown: This is retrospective prediction within the study cohort; the AUC peak does not establish prospective performance, clinical utility, or improved fertilization outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: Random Forest and XGBoost combine clinical variables with first polar body (PBI) morphology from oocyte images to predict 2PN fertilization after ICSI.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
